subject: Consolidated feedback: Jackson Patel (SWE II) - panel debrief
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: hiring@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Feedback requested: Jackson Patel (SWE II) - onsite panel (4/19)

Hi all,

Thanks again for taking the time to interview Jackson yesterday. Quick request — please share your scorecards and a 2–3 bullet summary of any risks or strong signals by 12pm PT today so I can pull together a consolidated note for the hiring committee.

I've attached the blank scorecard in case you want to fill and upload (attachment: scorecard-jp-blank.pdf). I also started a short doc to capture notes: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2B3C-jp-debrief — feel free to paste your bullets there or reply inline.

Key areas I care about: technical depth, system design, ownership signals, and culture fit. If you have a red flag (security, behavioral, or skill mismatch), call it out explicitly.

Proposed next step: compile consensus and propose either (A) final on-site loop or (B) pass. I'll aim to share a recommendation by EOD.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Hiring Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Feedback requested: Jackson Patel (SWE II) - onsite panel (4/19)

On Tue, Apr 20, 2027 at 9:12 AM Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for taking the time to interview Jackson yesterday. Quick request — please share your scorecards and a 2–3 bullet summary of any risks or strong signals by 12pm PT today so I can pull together a consolidated note for the hiring committee.

Thanks, Soojin — notes below and I uploaded a quick filled scorecard to the doc.

Summary bullets:
- Technical competence: solid foundations in backend Java and distributed systems, 3/5.
- System design: reasonable approach for sharded KV, missed a few tradeoffs on stateful recovery, 4/5.
- Ownership/communication: clear, asked good questions about constraints, 4/5.
- Risk: limited exposure to high-throughput pub/sub (we use this heavily).

Recommend: move to final onsite loop (with a short deep-dive on pub/sub patterns).

Laura
Principal SWE, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Feedback requested: Jackson Patel (SWE II) - onsite panel (4/19)

On Tue, Apr 20, 2027 at 10:05 AM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks, Soojin — notes below and I uploaded a quick filled scorecard to the doc.

Quick notes — pasted from my local file (attachment: interview-notes-marcus.txt):
- Strong debugging instincts and clean follow-ups.
- When I pushed on concurrency for the KV path, he suggested a lock-based approach that could bottleneck at high TPS.
- No clear exposure to horizontal scaling of streaming pipelines (concern).

Score (my scale): Technical 3, Systems 3, Communication 4.

If we move forward, recommend a focused systems interview on pub/sub and high-concurrency patterns.

— Marcus
Senior SWE, Runtime Performance

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Feedback requested: Jackson Patel (SWE II) - onsite panel (4/19)

Adding my notes inline to the doc — short summary:
- Culture fit: asked thoughtful questions about on-call and postmortems; seems collaborative.
- Product sense: decent, could push harder on tradeoffs when asked.
- Overall: recommend final loop with behavioral and a deeper systems probe.

My scores: Technical 4, Systems 3, Collaboration 4.

No blocking red flags from me.

Marissa Cole
Staff PM, Serving Runtime

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: hiring@redwood.com, people-ops@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Feedback requested: Jackson Patel (SWE II) - onsite panel (4/19) — consolidated

Thanks everyone for the quick turn. Consolidating the panel feedback below and proposing next steps.

Panel raw scores (per interviewer):
- Laura: Tech 3 / Systems 4 / Collaboration 4
- Marcus: Tech 3 / Systems 3 / Communication 4
- Marissa: Tech 4 / Systems 3 / Collaboration 4

Aggregated averages (rounded): Technical 3.3, Systems 3.3, Collaboration 4.0

Signals:
- Strengths: clear communicator, ownership signals, good behavioral fit for cross-team work.
- Risks: limited exposure to high-throughput pub/sub and some noisy design decisions around concurrency under load.

Recommendation: Move to final onsite loop (2 interviewers focused on streaming/pub-sub + one hire manager deep-dive). We should specifically include a systems deep-dive and a short coding exercise that focuses on concurrency patterns.

Owner for next steps: Laura — could you own scheduling the final loop this week? If anyone strongly disagrees, flag it here before 6pm PT; otherwise I'll push this as the hiring committee recommendation.

I'll also attach an aggregated scorecard (attachment: jp-aggregated-scorecard.pdf) and update Greenhouse: https://greenhouse.example/candidates/56821

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
Hiring Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
